findings.where: Style tile, the section labels: 'Palette' and 'An article page' (left column, desktop; on phone too) against 'Texture', 'Type pair' and 'Motion sketch'
findings.fault: The five section labels are the same part but are styled two ways. 'Texture', 'Type pair' and 'Motion sketch' each have a hairline rule under the label. 'Palette' and 'An article page' have none, so their content starts straight under a bare label. Nothing in the content explains the difference. It reads as a slip, not as two kinds of section.
findings.who_objects: The designers of the layout round (#8 round 2) and the animation round (#9), who take this tile as the system to build inside. They can't tell whether a section heading takes a rule. Angélique, copying the article page's look for a new post, would get whichever version she happens to see.

findings.where: Motion sketch, the principle words 'calm, precise, light' (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: The principle words are set as a display line in Source Sans 3 semibold at heading size. The tile's own type pair gives Source Sans 3 to 'the nav, buttons, labels and dates only' and gives display to Gelasio. The tile's one display line in sans breaks the rule the tile sets two sections earlier.
findings.who_objects: The layout and animation rounds, who will read this as permission for sans display headings. That weakens the single Georgia-like voice that the v5 direction is built on, where the site and the logo share one voice.
